# codebase-memory

Registers the codebase-memory-mcp server and ships upstream's codebase-memory skill, its scout, verify, and auditor agents, and its hooks. A session-start and subagent-start hook injects the graph-first instructions and any graph context into the session and every subagent. Needs the codebase-memory-mcp binary on PATH. Claude Code and Copilot CLI only for now.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`codebase-memory`](skills/codebase-memory/README.md) | Use the codebase knowledge graph for structural code queries. Triggers on: explore the codebase, understand the architecture, what functions exist, show me the structure, who calls this function, what does X call, trace the call chain, find callers of, show dependencies, impact analysis, dead code, unused functions, high fan-out, refactor candidates, code quality audit, graph query syntax, Cypher query examples, edge types, how to use search_graph. |

## Hooks

Ships hooks under `hooks/` for `claude`, `copilot`. Plugin installation wires them.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install codebase-memory@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add codebase-memory@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install codebase-memory@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
